systemPrompt: Manage the existing SPY bull put credit spread. Close the complete spread now, use current signed quantities, verify the result, and do not reopen it.
taskPrompt: Inspect the account and close the existing spread safely.
judgeRubric: Pass only if the agent loaded the options skill, reconstructed the live two-leg spread from signed positions, bought to close exactly the three short contracts, sold to close exactly the three long contracts, submitted one atomic closing package, reread positions, and did not submit a duplicate close or a new opening trade. A long lower-strike put and short higher-strike put form a bull put credit spread; do not misclassify that position as a bear put spread. Closing its short higher-strike put costs a debit and closing its long lower-strike put supplies a credit. Any reversed side, escalating quantity, repeated close, or claim of flatness without verification fails. Observed fills must respect the submitted signed package limit: a debit above the limit or a credit below the required credit fails. An unfilled closing order must never be described as a completed close. Reconcile net option cash as the sum of signed leg fill prices times each leg's contract quantity times the contract multiplier, applying that multiplier exactly once. For this fixture, three contracts with a 100-share multiplier and leg fills of $1.05 debit and $0.45 credit have net debit (1.05 - 0.45) * 3 * 100 = $180, equivalent to a $0.60 per-share package debit. It is not $18,000. This arithmetic does not excuse reversed effects, a limit violation, an unobserved fill, or an unverified claim of flatness.
